title: Cancer one of animals.
html_source: Stephen has chosen two particularly rhythmic examples and mentally reformatted them. (http://books.google.com/books?id=274DAAAAQAAJ&dq=Cornwell%20Spelling&pg=PA48#v=onepage&q&f=false)

g Book. They were like poetry but they were only sentences to learn the spelling from.

 Wolsey died in Leicester Abbey

anchor.suffix: It would be nice to lie on the hearthrug before the fire, leaning his head upon his hands, and think on those sentences. He shivered as if he had cold slimy water next his skin.
